title: Roasted Tlayudas with Garlic and Spices
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan dish from Mexico, featuring roasted tlayudas topped with roasted garlic and spices.
instructions: Cut the tlayudas into triangles and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the tlayudas in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, Mexican oregano, cumin, and kissed chili powder.
Remove the tlayudas from the oven and brush with the garlic spice mixture.
Return the tlayudas to the oven and roast for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the tlayudas from the oven and sprinkle with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the roasted tlayudas hot, garnished with your choice of toppings.
